zh: AI 对话支持多会话：历史会话随时切换，退出后自动恢复
AI 对话新增联网搜索，回答附带来源链接
新增 Deep Research 深度研究模式，可生成完整调研报告
登录简化为一步直达 GitHub 授权，失败时给出更明确的提示
Product Hunt 条目的点击、分享、收藏均直达原帖
分享按钮移出菜单独立展示；修复每日提醒可能不准时的问题
en: AI chat now supports multiple sessions: switch between conversations anytime, with automatic restore
Web search in AI chat, with source links in answers
New Deep Research mode for generating in-depth research reports
Simplified sign-in that goes straight to GitHub authorization, with clearer error messages
Product Hunt items now link directly to the original post for view, share, and favorite
Share button is now shown directly on cards; fixed daily reminder timing drift
